response.text:
I can’t add events to your calendar or claim the appointment is “done” because no calendar tools are available and I don’t have access to your calendar. I can, however, prepare the event details and an importable .ics file or give step-by-step instructions so you can add it yourself.

Summary / computed date
- “Next Wednesday” after 2028-08-21 (America/Los_Angeles) is 2028-08-23.
- You requested “at 2” — please confirm 2:00 AM or 2:00 PM (I assume 2:00 PM unless you tell me otherwise).

I need two small clarifications before I generate an import file or a ready-to-paste event:
1. Is the time 2:00 PM (14:00) or 2:00 AM (02:00)?  
2. Preferred duration (unspecified) — suggest 1 hour unless you prefer otherwise.  
3. Target calendar (e.g., Personal, Work) and location (optional).  
4. Reminders/notifications (e.g., 30 minutes before).

If you want me to proceed with reasonable defaults (2:00 PM, 1 hour, no location, default calendar, 30-minute reminder), I will generate a ready-to-import .ics text you can save as dentist.ics and import into Google Calendar / Apple Calendar / Outlook. Example .ics with those defaults (save as a file named dentist.ics and import):

BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Assistant//EN
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:20280823T140000-001@example.com
SUMMARY:Dentist appointment
DTSTART:20280823T140000
DTEND:20280823T150000
DESCRIPTION:
LOCATION:
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR

Quick manual steps (Google Calendar)
1. Open Google Calendar.
2. Click Create.
3. Title: "Dentist appointment"
4. Date: Aug 23, 2028. Time: 2:00 PM — 3:00 PM (America/Los_Angeles).
5. Choose calendar (Personal/Work), add location if desired, set reminder (e.g., 30 minutes).
6. Save.

Quick manual steps (Apple Calendar)
1. Open Calendar and click the + for the date.
2. Enter title and time (Aug 23, 2028; 2:00 PM — 3:00 PM).
3. Add location and alert if desired.
4. Click Add.

Quick manual steps (Outlook)
1. New Event → Title: "Dentist appointment".
2. Date/time: Aug 23, 2028, 2:00 PM — 3:00 PM (select correct time zone).
3. Choose calendar, add location/alerts, Save & Close.

What I can do now
- Generate a full .ics file with your confirmed choices for you to import.
- Create a text-ready event for you to copy into a calendar UI.
- Provide more detailed instructions for a specific calendar app.

Which do you want? And please confirm AM/PM, duration, target calendar, and any reminder.
